Class CardDeck

java.lang.Object
CardDeck
public class CardDeck extends Object
Represents deck of cards made up of Card objects. Deck contains suspect, weapon, and room cards. Creates case file, shuffles cards, and deals cards to players.

      public void createCaseFile()
      Creates the hidden case file for the game. Removes one suspect, one weapon, and one room from the deck and adds it to the case file. The selection process makes sure that the cards chosen are random.
